targets.name: nginx-rate-limited
targets.planted_condition: nginx limit_req (rate=18r/m, burst=2): allows exactly 3 requests per 10s from a single client IP, and returns 429 Too Many Requests with recognizable JSON body starting at the 4th request

expectations.why: First 3 requests within window return 200, 4th request is rate-limited (429) within threshold+2 bound
waf.low_rate_limit.safe uses observation-only probe kind rate_limit_sequence (E2); correlation engine returns inconclusive without establishing readiness credit
l7.low_rate_rate_limit.safe uses observation-only probe kind rate_limit_sequence (E2); correlation engine returns inconclusive without establishing readiness credit

targets.name: nginx-unlimited
targets.planted_condition: nginx without rate limiting: all requests return 200 OK without throttling

expectations.why: Origin has no rate limit configured; all canary requests succeed with 200 OK exceeding threshold 3 without rate limiting
l7/waf rate_limit_sequence probes are observation-only (E2); correlation engine returns inconclusive regardless of origin response
l7/waf rate_limit_sequence probes are observation-only (E2); correlation engine returns inconclusive regardless of origin response

verification:
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}
' http://172.31.52.10/canary for 4 rapid requests yields 200, 200, 200, 429
curl -s http://172.31.52.10/canary on the 4th request returns recognizable JSON body {"error":"rate_limited","message":"Rate limit exceeded: 3 requests per 10s"}
